title: Auto Metrics Row
description: One row per Claude Code SessionEnd (real close only, not compact/clear). v3 adds five conversation-shape signals: tool_errors_count, subagent_invocations, user_msg_count, short_user_followups_count, correction_keyword_hits. v2 dropped permission_mode.

ts.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the row was written

duration_s.description: Seconds between first and last transcript entry. null if unknown or implausibly long (>24h — almost always a stale resumed transcript).

tool_distribution.description: Map of tool name → invocation count

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost. null if model is unknown and no _default fallback applied.

tool_errors_count.description: Number of tool_result blocks marked is_error=true. Indicates failing tools or retry loops.

subagent_invocations.description: Map of subagent_type → invocation count, captured from Agent tool_use input. Empty object if no Agent tool was used.

user_msg_count.description: Number of user-authored text messages (excluding tool_result-only synthetic user entries).

short_user_followups_count.description: User messages (after the first) under 200 chars. High counts indicate the user steering with short corrections rather than full prompts.

correction_keyword_hits.description: Number of user messages matching correction-style keywords (undo, revert, rollback, redo, incorrect, wrong, broken, doesn't work, not what i asked/wanted). English-only conservative set; meant for retro pre-fill, not as a strict correction rate.

end_reason.description: Always 'close'. /compact and /clear are filtered at the hook.

error.description: If present, indicates the hook could not fully parse the transcript. Other fields may be zero/null.
